comment: THE FILE KINDS A TRACEABILITY-INVENTORY ANCHOR INTO A DOCUMENT IS RESOLVED BY THE AUDIT, NOT BY A COMPILER TEST (kb/Work PB4453). A row's code-location (and a path#Symbol its notes spell) names a file and a symbol in it. SpecTraceabilityInventoryDriftTests resolves the symbol in every file kind but these; an anchor into one of these (today every one is a docs/CONFORMANCE.md#DOC-A.1-n or #DRV-n anchor) is resolved by scripts/docchecks/inventory.py, because no compiler test opens a Markdown file. The two lists are this one file.
